title: Marshawn Lynch celebrates Seahawks Super Bowl win in Nike ad: 'Tastes good'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Marshawn Lynch celebrates Seahawks Super Bowl win in Nike ad: 'Tastes good'
sources.description: Nike celebrated the Seahawks' Super Bowl 60 win with an ad featuring Marshawn Lynch claiming 'nothing tastes as good as getting your lick back.'
